svg.title: From Yacht Sale Price to Broker Take-Home
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-yacht-commission-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: From Yacht Sale Price to Broker Take-Home; subtitle: Tiered schedule, co-broker split, and house split; caption: A $30M yacht carries a potential $1.75M commission on the tiered schedule. Co-broker and house splits then cut what a single working broker keeps.; assumptions note: Each stage restates a separate practitioner example rather than one continuous deal. The $1M commission is the Yacht Broker Masterclass illustration, and the 60/40 split applies under most circumstances.; note: Schedule and $30M example from a Northrop & Johnson broker on Yachts For Sale. Split and take-home figures from Yacht Broker Masterclass.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Brokerage Yacht Sale Price; value: 30000000; display: $30M; conversion: Starting sale price; detail: Yacht Sale Price used in the Yachts For Sale example.; label: Potential Tiered Commission; value: 1750000; display: $1.75M; conversion: 10% first $10M, 5% next $10M, 2.5% per $10M after; detail: Standard brokerage-yacht schedule quoted by a Northrop & Johnson broker.; label: Illustrative Commission Pool; value: 1000000; display: $1M; conversion: Shared between buyer and seller brokers; detail: Commission pool used in the Yacht Broker Masterclass split example.; label: Buyer-Side Broker Keep; value: 300000; display: $300K; conversion: 60% buyer side, then a 50/50 house split; detail: The seller-side broker on the same 50/50 house split keeps $200,000.; label: Junior Broker Net; value: 80000; display: $80K; conversion: Junior on a 20% house split; detail: What a junior on a 20% house split nets off a $1M commission.

text.title: From Yacht Sale Price to Broker Take-Home
text.tspan: From Yacht Sale Price to Broker Take-Home

rect.title: label: Brokerage Yacht Sale Price; value: 30000000; display: $30M; conversion: Starting sale price; detail: Yacht Sale Price used in the Yachts For Sale example.

label: Potential Tiered Commission; value: 1750000; display: $1.75M; conversion: 10% first $10M, 5% next $10M, 2.5% per $10M after; detail: Standard brokerage-yacht schedule quoted by a Northrop & Johnson broker.
label: Illustrative Commission Pool; value: 1000000; display: $1M; conversion: Shared between buyer and seller brokers; detail: Commission pool used in the Yacht Broker Masterclass split example.
label: Buyer-Side Broker Keep; value: 300000; display: $300K; conversion: 60% buyer side, then a 50/50 house split; detail: The seller-side broker on the same 50/50 house split keeps $200,000.
label: Junior Broker Net; value: 80000; display: $80K; conversion: Junior on a 20% house split; detail: What a junior on a 20% house split nets off a $1M commission.

text.title: Assumptions: Each stage restates a separate practitioner example rather than one continuous deal. The $1M commission is the Yacht Broker Masterclass illustration, and the 60/40 split applies under most circumstances.
